english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being accountable or having duties, including a duty-bearing position.
Use this when the obligation is placed on a person or group.

examples.english: They are responsible for looking after the elderly.
examples.traditional: 佢哋有責任照顧老人家。

examples.english: As the estate management company, it is incumbent on them to follow up on this complaint.
examples.traditional: 作為屋苑管理公司，佢哋有責任跟進呢單投訴。
